content: We collected the RUN dataset using Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk), allowing only native English speakers to perform the task. We collected instructions based on three different areas, all in urban, dense parts of Manhattan. The size of each map is $0.5$ $km^{2}$. The dataset contains 2515 navigation instructions (equal to 389 complete paragraphs) paired with their routes. The paragraphs are crowd-sourced from 389 different instructors, of which style and language vary BIBREF18.
